card.name: Words just before a timing or follow-up clause
card.fires_on: Words in treatment instructions where a time or sequence phrase is about to follow, such as 'whether or not', 'immediately following', 'as soon as remembered', 'if a dose is missed,'. Also fires inside 'acetylcysteine' and on 'overdose' after 'treatment of'.

modes.label: Timing and sequence words
modes.description: Words in instructions that lead into a when-or-after phrase, such as missed doses or following an event.
modes.example: If a dose of SIMTRIYO is missed, administer the missed dose as soon as<< remembered>> but no later than 4 hours after

modes.label: Overdose treatment wording
modes.description: The word overdose after 'treatment of', and the middle of acetylcysteine in acetaminophen overdose text.
modes.example: hemodialysis is likely to be ineffective in the treatment of<< overdose>> with TAFINLAR.

modes.label: Decision or action wording
modes.description: A linking word or action word in step-by-step directions, such as 'whether or not' or 'apply gentle pressure'.
modes.example: to determine whether<< or>> not to initiate treatment with acetylc

card.writes: Promoted tokens are mixed and unclear, while the suppressed ones are words like 'afterwards' and 'aftermath', so it mildly lowers after-the-fact wording.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in instructions that point to what to do next or when, such as missed doses or overdose care.
